title: Compare two optimal solvers
description: Run A* and Dijkstra on the same weighted grid. Both find cost 26 in this example. Expansion counts describe this map, not a universal speed advantage.
timestamp_basis: Image filesystem modification time; exact capture event was not retained

title: Traffic as a modeled cost
description: Select the rush-hour scenario. Increased tile costs make a six-cost detour preferable to the seven-cost reference path; these are synthetic costs, not live traffic.

title: Inspect the map on a narrow screen
description: Use the same congestion scenario in the responsive browser layout. This screenshot checks presentation, not a physical phone.

title: Find a fragile crossing
description: Run the single-tile closure sweep. Three of 69 tested closures disconnect this map. Each trial closes one tile independently.

title: Test a proposed improvement
description: Add the second crossing and repeat the sweep. All 70 tested single-tile closures remain connected; the maximum added route cost is two in this scenario.

title: Read the recorded benchmark
description: Inspect the 90 recorded rows and their route/expansion results. These are historical runs, separate from the current map calculation.

title: Call the solver API
description: Send POST /api/compare through the application console. The local server returns HTTP 200 and the two algorithms agree on detour cost six.

title: Reject an invalid grid
description: Send an empty grid. The server returns HTTP 400 with a grid validation error instead of constructing an invalid route.
